# Hyred — AI-Powered Job Search Platform

> Hyred (hyred.in) is an AI job-search dashboard that matches users to the right jobs, scores their fit, generates tailored resumes, and auto-fills applications.

## What Hyred Does

- **Job Matching**: AI scores how well your resume matches each job (0-100 fit score)
- **Resume Tailoring**: Generates a customized resume optimized for each specific job
- **Cover Letter Generation**: AI writes personalized cover letters per job
- **ATS Resume Checker**: Scores your resume against Applicant Tracking Systems
- **Auto-Apply**: Chrome extension that fills job applications automatically
- **Job Aggregation**: Ingests jobs from LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Adzuna, and 30+ ATS platforms

## Public Pages (no auth required)

- `/explore` — Browse and search all indexed jobs. Supports `?q=` search and `?source=` filter.
- `/explore/[id]` — Individual job page with full description, company info, and structured data.
- `/free-tools/ats-score-checker` — Free ATS resume scoring tool.
- `/login` — Sign in / sign up.
- `/contact` — Contact form.
- `/privacy` — Privacy policy.
- `/terms` — Terms of service.

## Public API (no auth required)

### Search Jobs
```
GET /api/explore/search?q={keyword}&source={source}&page={n}
```
Returns paginated job listings matching the query. Each result includes:
- `id`, `title`, `company`, `location`, `remote`, `salary`, `source`, `posted_at`, `tags`, `url`

### Get Job Details
```
GET /api/explore/job/{id}
```
Returns full job details including description, structured data, and apply URL.

## Authenticated API (requires Hyred account)

- `POST /api/coverletter` — Generate AI cover letter for a job match
- `POST /api/ats-checker` — Score a resume against ATS criteria
- `POST /api/ats-fix` — Get AI suggestions to improve resume ATS score
- `POST /api/dream-companies` — Set up job alerts for dream companies

## Data Schema (JSON-LD)

Job pages use schema.org `JobPosting` structured data:
- `title`, `description`, `datePosted`, `employmentType`
- `hiringOrganization` (company name)
- `jobLocation` (city/region)
- `offers` (salary if available)
